invariants.statement: A coordination reservation is not flight authorization unless a competent authority explicitly defines and issues it as such.
A strategy or simulation result cannot replace onboard or approved tactical detect-and-avoid/separation functions.
A route/trajectory comparison requires qualified spatial reference, vertical datum, time basis, validity interval, and uncertainty semantics.
Missing, stale, contradictory, or unqualified inputs cannot produce a clear-to-fly classification.
Reputation, consensus, record validity, or a signed receipt does not prove physical safety, authorization, or certification.
Safety constraints are non-compensatory; throughput, cost, noise, and fairness cannot trade away a hard safety gate.

Every flight geometry evaluation requires an explicit traffic-profile/model-profile pair admitted by a versioned applicability registry; unknown, missing, or unsupported pairs remain unresolved before geometric work.

cases.name: stale_flight_intent
cases.stimulus: The intent validity interval expires before reservation activation or preflight recheck.
cases.required_behavior: Require a refreshed intent and repeat the relevant conflict assessment.
cases.forbidden_inference: Historical conflict-free intent remains current after expiry.

cases.name: coordinate_frame_or_vertical_datum_mismatch
cases.stimulus: Two trajectory inputs use incompatible or unspecified spatial reference systems or vertical datums.
cases.required_behavior: Require an explicit qualified transformation and preserve transformation provenance before comparison.
cases.forbidden_inference: Numerically similar coordinates represent the same physical location.

cases.name: unqualified_clock_or_excessive_clock_skew
cases.stimulus: Time inputs lack a qualified time basis or exceed the selected profile's permitted skew.
cases.required_behavior: Do not compare space-time occupancy as authoritative until time qualification is restored.
cases.forbidden_inference: Timestamps from different clocks are interchangeable because they share a numeric representation.

cases.name: duplicate_or_replayed_reservation
cases.stimulus: An authenticated or unauthenticated duplicate message attempts to re-apply an old reservation state.
cases.required_behavior: Use version, issuer, validity and replay-protection semantics; preserve the rejected event for audit.
cases.forbidden_inference: A valid historical signature makes an expired state current.

cases.name: overlapping_trajectory_tubes
cases.stimulus: Two current, qualified trajectory envelopes overlap in space and time under the applicable assessment profile.
cases.required_behavior: Do not present the pair as conflict-free; request replanning or a competent operational resolution.
cases.forbidden_inference: Nominal centerlines that do not cross prove robust separation.

cases.name: emergency_traffic_insertion
cases.stimulus: An emergency mission arrives after ordinary reservations have been issued.
cases.required_behavior: Apply the applicable emergency-priority policy, assess affected reservations and contingencies, and do not prescribe physically impossible maneuvers.
cases.forbidden_inference: Emergency priority by itself proves every requested path is feasible or safe.

cases.name: communications_loss_or_provider_partition
cases.stimulus: Federated providers lose connectivity or cannot reconcile a reservation update.
cases.required_behavior: Use only the prequalified partition/degraded-mode policy; block unsupported new coordination claims and preserve local onboard safety behavior.
cases.forbidden_inference: A central service or remote network remains available just because the last response was valid.

cases.name: navigation_integrity_degraded
cases.stimulus: GNSS spoofing suspicion, sensor disagreement, stale observations, or uncertainty growth invalidates the selected navigation profile.
cases.required_behavior: Mark the capability/intent as degraded and defer the actual contingency to the qualified vehicle and operation profile.
cases.forbidden_inference: Network connectivity or a prior route authorization restores physical navigation integrity.

cases.name: weather_or_airspace_constraint_changes
cases.stimulus: A new weather hazard, temporary restriction, landing-site closure, or protected volume intersects a planned trajectory.
cases.required_behavior: Invalidate affected planning claims and recompute under the new versioned constraints.
cases.forbidden_inference: A plan remains valid because its original inputs were valid at submission time.

cases.name: non_cooperative_or_untracked_traffic
cases.stimulus: Traffic may be present but lacks sufficient qualified intent or tracking data.
cases.required_behavior: Do not assume empty airspace; use approved traffic-awareness and detect-and-avoid procedures, escalating to the competent operational process where required.

cases.name: infeasible_corridor_without_escape_options
cases.stimulus: A corridor constraint leaves no trajectory satisfying the declared vehicle dynamics, uncertainty envelope, and contingency requirements.
cases.required_behavior: Report infeasibility or request another route/capacity decision rather than silently weakening the constraint.
cases.forbidden_inference: Higher utilization makes an infeasible route acceptable.

cases.name: simulation_pass_presented_as_operational_approval
cases.stimulus: A successful simulated scenario is submitted as evidence that a real flight or deployed service is authorized/safe.
cases.required_behavior: Retain simulation as simulation evidence within its declared model and scenario limits; require the independent operational approval path.
cases.forbidden_inference: Simulation success establishes airworthiness, certification, or permission to fly.

cases.name: record_or_reputation_used_as_safety_authority
cases.stimulus: A valid provenance receipt, quorum, reputation score, or protocol validation is used as the sole basis for a safety/authorization claim.
cases.required_behavior: Require the relevant authoritative decision and qualified engineering/operational evidence.
cases.forbidden_inference: Protocol integrity or social consensus proves physical safety.

cases.name: one_provider_claims_conflicting_authoritative_views
cases.stimulus: Federated providers report incompatible active reservations for the same qualified space-time resource without a declared conflict state.
cases.required_behavior: Expose the inconsistency and reconcile under explicit issuer/version/authority rules before presenting a unified current state.
cases.forbidden_inference: A merged projection can hide contradictions while remaining authoritative.

cases.name: hard_safety_gate_traded_for_throughput
cases.stimulus: An optimizer ranks a candidate with a violated hard safety predicate above feasible alternatives due to throughput, cost, or noise score.
cases.required_behavior: Apply hard safety predicates before optimization and keep the violated gate visible in the result.
cases.forbidden_inference: A favorable aggregate score compensates for a hard safety violation.

cases.name: missing_model_applicability_binding
cases.stimulus: A flight intent omits traffic_profile_id or model_profile_id, or supplies an empty identifier.
cases.required_behavior: Return unresolved before trajectory, dynamic-constraint, or polygon intersection work; do not infer a default model from coordinates.
cases.forbidden_inference: Missing model metadata means the default or simplest kernel applies.

cases.name: real_world_traffic_profile_paired_with_toy_kernel
cases.stimulus: A catalogued real-world archetype such as conventional_fixed_wing, evtol_aam, low_altitude_multirotor_uas, or launch_reentry_suborbital is paired with the constant_velocity_toy_v1 model.
cases.required_behavior: Reject the model/profile combination as unsupported before performing any geometric intersection work; preserve the declared unsupported model status.
cases.forbidden_inference: A valid local Cartesian coordinate and velocity record establish applicability to a real vehicle.

cases.name: direct_polygon_api_bypasses_model_admission
cases.stimulus: A caller sends a valid-looking FlightIntent directly to the planar polygon API with an unsupported traffic/model pair.
cases.required_behavior: Apply the same fail-closed model-applicability gate in the polygon entry point and record zero geometric work.
cases.forbidden_inference: A lower-level geometry function may bypass the traffic-model admission contract.

evaluation_metrics.name: hard_safety_gate_violations
evaluation_metrics.notes: Thresholds must come from the applicable authority and validated operation profile; this contract does not invent universal separation minima.

evaluation_metrics.name: unsupported_model_profile_admission
evaluation_metrics.notes: Every geometry entry point must fail closed before geometric work when the traffic/model pair is missing or unsupported; this gate is not a learned score or performance objective.

prototype.results_interpretation: Passing means only that the simplified model matches synthetic fixture expectations; it is not safety, airworthiness, certification, or permission to fly.

reservation_semantics.emergency: does_not_automatically_preempt_existing_claim; applicable jurisdictional priority rules are not implemented
reservation_semantics.authority_ceiling: snapshot conflict assessment only; not reservation allocation or flight authorization

reservation_event_semantics.sequence_scope: strict per-reservation stream; starts at sequence 1 and must be contiguous
reservation_event_semantics.predecessor_link: opaque prior-event identifier; this prototype does not compute or authenticate digests
reservation_event_semantics.event_order: arrival order is ignored; sequence is sorted, but gaps and forks are unresolved
reservation_event_semantics.retransmission: only field-for-field identical typed event records after schema parsing are deduplicated
reservation_event_semantics.mutable_fields: resource, trajectory, time basis, interval, expiry, priority, and provider remain fixed within one reservation stream
reservation_event_semantics.active_projection: latest Accepted or Activated event when not expired or ended
reservation_event_semantics.cross_provider: conflicts are surfaced; no winner, global causal order, or reservation grant
reservation_event_semantics.authority_ceiling: synthetic provider-local event replay and reservation conflict screen only

dynamic_constraint_semantics.volume_model: synthetic axis-aligned box in explicit local frame, vertical datum and time basis
dynamic_constraint_semantics.temporal_semantics: half-open [valid_from_s, valid_until_s); an intersection exactly at valid_until_s is excluded
dynamic_constraint_semantics.update_order: per-constraint contiguous sequence with predecessor linkage; arrival order is not authoritative
dynamic_constraint_semantics.withdrawal: latest withdrawn version removes the constraint from the current synthetic view; does not restore flight authorization or certify safety
dynamic_constraint_semantics.intersection: continuous-time analytical slab intersection for constant-velocity trajectories against expanded axis-aligned boxes, bounded by constraint/flight pair checks
dynamic_constraint_semantics.stale_snapshot: known intersections remain reassessment_required; absence of observed intersection in stale/partitioned view is degraded
dynamic_constraint_semantics.authority_ceiling: impact evidence only; competent service decides how to update or withdraw authorizations
dynamic_constraint_semantics.uncertainty_envelope: declared flight uncertainty + constraint margin + absolute velocity scaled by a caller-specified synthetic uncertainty horizon
dynamic_constraint_semantics.sampling: no temporal point-sampling to detect geometric intersection; report records intersection checks, not sample checks
